sections.Profile:
"Eager Beaver" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Corporation in 1965. Designed by Norm Clark, with artwork by Art Stenholm, the game features a whimsical beaver theme, incorporating playful and colorful artwork. ​ The playfield includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, one passive bumper, two slingshots, four rollover buttons, three drop targets, two ball kickers, and two standup targets.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
